items.summary: Security disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private preview. Evidence: password-gated private preview with noindex/nofollow; security, operations, and fleet-doctor telemetry provide no completed deployment, uptime, error, authentication, authorization, secret-handling, runtime-isolation, release-control, dependency, monitoring, or incident evidence. TLS is only technically indicated by the compliance scan and does not establish complete TLS configuration. No security.txt or disclosure-contact evidence is present. Severity is high for public exposure because alert rules, sync results, operational logs, and hosting data are in scope. Recommend retaining keep_private and requiring owner-approved evidence for access boundaries, secrets, isolation, TLS, release controls, dependency provenance and vulnerability handling, data minimization, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness. Do not approve sitemap, monetization expansion, credentials, schedules, production changes, or go-live.

The available security baseline is read-only triage, not penetration testing or certification. Missing telemetry is evidence of an unresolved control gap, not evidence of compromise or a clean bill of health. Continue only the private-preview posture and existing approved measurement work.
